blocks.x: Mair Morgan describes how her father built his own water turbine and supplied the three villages of Ysbyty Ystwyth, Pontrhydygroes and New Row with domestic power. This was a private venture, and he billed using meter-boxes, which her collected yearly from households to pay for the project. A true Wild West survival story
